meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 接到格式化请求后,Claude 会读取文件:纯文本会转成带标题、加粗、列表等结构的 Markdown;已有 Markdown 会先让用户选择优化、保留原格式或仅修排版。随后保存为「原名-formatted.md」,并运行脚本修复引号、中英文间距和强调标点。
howto.when: 当用户说「格式化 Markdown」「美化文章」「添加格式」等,或要求改进文章排版时触发。

say.text: 把这份文档格式化,输出为 xxx-formatted.md
say.note: 会生成带 frontmatter 和标题层级的新文件。

say.text: 帮我美化这篇文章,加上摘要和粗体重点
say.note: 会先让你选优化方式,再生成新文件。

say.text: 只做排版修复,别加标题和列表
say.note: 在原文件上直接修引号和间距,不生成副本。

howto.what_en: Reads the file; plain text becomes structured Markdown (headings, bold, lists, frontmatter). Existing Markdown prompts user to choose optimize/keep/typography-only. Saves as {filename}-formatted.md and runs typography script (quotes, spacing, emphasis).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'format markdown', 'beautify article', 'add formatting', or improve article layout.

say_en.text: Format this document and save it as xxx-formatted.md.
say_en.note: Creates a new file with frontmatter and heading structure.

say_en.text: Beautify this article — add a summary and bold key points.
say_en.note: Asks how to proceed, then generates a formatted copy.

say_en.text: Only fix typography; don't add titles or lists.
say_en.note: Fixes quotes and spacing directly in the original file.
